card.title: PS5 Southbridge IC troubleshooting and power rail identification

source.title: PlayStation 5 Southbridge Area Test Points and Power Rails

symptoms: Console beeps 3 times but does not power on

claims.statement: Flux under BGA can cause oscillator problems
claims.evidence: Text note in the right margin

claims.statement: 3.3V STBY is required for power buttons to work
claims.evidence: Text note in the right margin

claims.statement: +1.1V must be generated for the Southbridge IC when power button is pressed
claims.evidence: Text note in the right margin

claims.statement: 32Khz clock signal power comes from standby power or battery
claims.evidence: Text note pointing to the 32Khz crystal

cautions: Flux under BGA can cause oscillator problems
card.caveats: The image does not provide specific voltage measurement points for the 3.3V STBY rail or the 25Mhz oscillator.
